name: grizzly-llm-instructions
description: Write agent skills with the writing-skills skill and lint them with skill-lint, which combines Vale rules and TypeSafe Jev judgments: line-level findings for prohibitions, history and padding, plus section and skill scores for goal, specificity, bounded choices, measurable criteria and reasons. Runs as a CLI or a pre-commit hook. Requires uv, Vale and a TYPESAFE_API_KEY.
